rows.reason: clock measures time, thermometer measures temperature; mercury and hour do not complete the measuring relation; key unique.
author writes a novel, composer writes a symphony; orchestra and note are not what a composer writes as a whole work; key unique.
shepherd tends sheep, beekeeper tends bees; sting and wool are wrong; key unique.
library holds books, gallery holds paintings; artist and frame are not what a gallery holds as its collection; key unique.
drought is a lack of rain, famine a lack of food; hunger is a result and crop a cause, neither the thing lacking; key unique.
captain leads a crew, conductor leads an orchestra; ship and violin wrong; key unique.
recipe is the plan for a meal, blueprint the plan for a building; brick and architect wrong; key unique.
chapter is part of a novel, scene part of a play; actor and line wrong; key unique.

Wet is a second correct answer. Warm is a mild form of hot exactly as damp is a mild form of wet, so damp:wet is the closest parallel to warm:hot; soaked would parallel something like scorching. The key is defensible but not the only correct option, and a child who answers wet has reasoned correctly. Change the pair (e.g. warm:scorching) or replace wet.
breeze is light wind and gale strong wind; shower to downpour is the same increase; drizzle goes the other way and puddle is a result; key unique.
whisper to shout is quiet to loud; glance to stare is brief to long look; peek is no stronger and blink is not a look; key unique.

Sniffle is ambiguous for a child: its everyday sense is the noise of a cold ("the sniffles"), and read that way sneeze is the bigger nasal noise, so the stem has two readings and the key depends on the crying sense. Roar as a laugh (roar with laughter) also relies on a figurative sense. Use an unambiguous crying word (e.g. whimper) as the stem.
annoyed is a mild form of furious, pleased a mild form of delighted; content is no stronger and calm is a different feeling; key unique.
wheat is made into flour, grape made into juice; skin is a part and vine the source; key unique.
sculptor works in marble, potter works in clay; handle and statue wrong; key unique.
herd is a group of cattle, flock a group of sheep; shepherd and wool wrong; key unique.

Note is also a part of a symphony, so a child applying "is a part of" (which is what novel:chapter shows) finds two correct options. What separates movement is that it is a named section like a chapter, which needs specialist musical vocabulary most 9-11 year olds will not have; the child who does not know movement will choose the part they do know. Replace note or the stem pair.

Country is a defensible second answer: a dictionary is full of words as an atlas is full of countries, and an atlas is organised by country as a dictionary is by word. Map is the better answer but not the only correct one. Replace country with a clearly wrong distractor.
Mercy is a second correct answer: mercy is an opposite of cruelty (merciful vs cruel) just as bravery is the opposite of cowardice. Replace mercy.

witness is a person at a trial, referee a person at a match; player is a person and whistle a tool, neither the event; the pair is loose (a judge would parallel a referee more closely) but match is the only option that completes it; key unique.

Dune is a defensible second answer: a grain of sand is a tiny piece of a dune just as a drop is a tiny piece of the ocean. Desert matches the vast scale of ocean better, but the row asks for the same relationship, which dune also satisfies. Replace dune.
sketch is the rough version before a painting, draft the rough version before an essay; outline comes before a draft and pen is a tool; key unique.

The first pair is loose: hesitate and act are not clean opposites, so the child must guess the relationship. Read as "hold back from doing", doubt holds back from accepting as much as from believing, so accept is also correct. Use a clean antonym or cause pair and replace accept.

apprentice grows into a master, sapling grows into a tree; oak is the only grown-tree option, branch is a part and acorn earlier; minor note that a sapling is not necessarily an oak, but no option competes; key unique.
